description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Carnival of Souls and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.
